what: The record does not establish that two or more people were jointly preparing something secretly from the mayor. It contains an unverified bakery bridge/port-change rumor, which the neighbour says the baker did not substantiate; routine bread sales and orders are described. A secretary-prepared draft mill-inspection letter was explicitly at the mayor's direction and for review, not secret. Thus no supported participants/helpers or covert preparation can be identified.
